name: free-and-cheap-tokens
description: MCP server + curated data for free and cheap AI model token promotions

scripts.preflight: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run check:p0
scripts.apify:validate: node -e "const a=require('./.actor/actor.json'); if(a.pricingModel!=='PAY_PER_EVENT') throw new Error('pricingModel must be PAY_PER_EVENT'); if(!a.webServer?.requestHandler) throw new Error('webServer.requestHandler required'); if(!a.usesStandbyMode) throw new Error('usesStandbyMode required: PPE actors need Standby to expose a stable public MCP endpoint'); const evts=a.pricingEvents||{}; const required=['mcp-initialize','mcp-search','mcp-filter','mcp-get-promo','mcp-list-providers','mcp-recent-updates','mcp-expiring-soon','mcp-what-can-i-get','mcp-report-issue']; const missing=required.filter(e=>!evts[e]); if(missing.length) throw new Error('missing pricingEvents: '+missing.join(',')); console.log('✓ actor.json PPE config valid');"

author: Free and Cheap Tokens Contributors
